positions.title: Next Gen Wearables Machine Learning Research Intern @ Ashu Lab
Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Analyzed and engineered big data using Python, Apache Spark, and SQL in Jupyter Notebook/Github and scripts to build digital behavior profiles on a PostgreSQL database for 1.8M+ users of company websites to detect fraudulent activity. 
• Automated the process using the Apache Oozie workflow scheduler for Hadoop to track frequency of displayed behaviors over time and create ~20K new profiles/hour for newly found users. 
• Documented data analysis, workflow pipelines, and database architecture and presented insights to VP-level stakeholders biweekly to show the business impact and progress.
